final: WITH st AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS stavg, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(stavg) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, SUM(cnt) AS telescope_count, SUM(cnt) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM st) AS fraction FROM st GROUP BY lunarstage
